objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed information object (policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction, etc.) that goes through creation, editing, release, distribution, and archiving.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the document (e.g. Policy, Guideline, Procedural Instruction, Work Instruction).

attributes.name: level
attributes.description: Hierarchical level in the document pyramid (1-4).

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Type abbreviation prefix used in the document name (e.g. RL).

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Cross-client consecutive 4-digit number per document type.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Human-readable title of the document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status (e.g. Editing, Released, Out of Force, Archived).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Current version number of the document.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the released version is valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the document remains valid.

attributes.name: validity_period
attributes.description: Configured period of extended validity (default 3 years).

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Configured archiving retention period (default 10 years).

attributes.name: original_language
attributes.description: Language in which the document was originally authored.

attributes.name: client
attributes.description: Client(s) in which the document is visible in a multi-client system.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Links to other documents, master data, IT applications, processes, etc.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Companies or areas of validity associated with the document.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled sub-document linked to a main document; released together with the main document and subject to its own versioning.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the attachment.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the attachment.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: A supplementary, non-controlled document addition that is not subject to the main document's release cycle.

attributes.name: published
attributes.description: Whether the additional info has been directly published via property switches.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A formal proposal to change an existing document, created by any author-rights holder without affecting the document's current content or version.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the change proposal (e.g. Created, Scheduled, Completed).

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: A system-generated request triggered 30 days before a document's validity expires, requiring a decision on extending validity.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the request.

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: A request to invalidate (put out of force) a released document and archive it.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the override request.

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: A request to reactivate a previously invalidated/archived document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the reactivation request.

objs.name: user
objs.description: An individual person who participates in document lifecycle processes in various roles.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the user.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A named group of users used for authorization and distribution assignment.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the user group (e.g. Reader - Document Management, Archive).

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A per-document list of user groups and persons who are notified about document releases.

attributes.name: distribution_type
attributes.description: Type of distribution: by e-mail or for acknowledgement.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: A workflow instance that supports processing of release, validity extension, override, reactivation, acknowledgement, or translation tasks.

attributes.name: workflow_type
attributes.description: Type of workflow (e.g. Release, Validity Extension, Override, Reactivation, Acknowledgement, Translation).

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the workflow.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: A predefined template associated with a document type, selectable when creating new documents.

attributes.name: format
attributes.description: Source format of the template (e.g. Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: A recorded signature by a workflow participant, documented per released version.

attributes.name: signer
attributes.description: The user who signed.

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time of the signature.

attributes.name: step
attributes.description: Workflow step during which the signature was provided (Creator, Review, Release).

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document object is created in the system with selection of document type and optional template.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: The selected document type for the new document.

attributes.name: template
attributes.description: The template selected for the new document, if any.

evts.name: edit_metadata
evts.description: Document properties and metadata attributes are maintained or updated.

attributes.name: category
attributes.description: The metadata category being edited (e.g. Master Data, Control).

evts.name: edit_content
evts.description: The content of a document is edited using the integrated editing client.

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: The document is automatically converted to PDF after saving.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Read or write authorizations are assigned to user groups or persons on a document.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: The role for which authorization is assigned (Reader, Author, Co-Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Translator).

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: The 3-step approval process (Creator-Review-Release) is initiated by the author or co-author.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: The registered author signs the Creator step of the release workflow with an electronic signature.

evts.name: complete_review
evts.description: A reviewer completes their review task (positive or rejection) in the release workflow.

attributes.name: outcome
attributes.description: Positive completion or rejection.

attributes.name: review_type
attributes.description: Technical or formal review.

evts.name: complete_release
evts.description: A releaser completes the release task (positive or rejection) in the release workflow.

attributes.name: outcome
attributes.description: Positive completion or rejection.

evts.name: reject_workflow
evts.description: A review or release step is rejected, canceling the workflow for all subsequent participants.

attributes.name: step
attributes.description: The workflow step at which rejection occurred.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: After release, the document is automatically published and made visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: A new editing version of a released document is automatically created when changes are triggered.

attributes.name: trigger
attributes.description: Reason for new version (content change, attribute change, attachment change, change proposal).

evts.name: create_attachment
evts.description: An attachment (controlled sub-document) is added to a document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: The content of an existing attachment is modified, triggering a new main document version.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is marked for archiving and archived upon release of the next main document version.

evts.name: create_additional_info
evts.description: An additional information object is added to a document.

evts.name: modify_additional_info
evts.description: An additional information object is updated. Does not affect the main document version.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: An additional information object is deleted. Does not affect the main document version.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is created for an existing released document.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is scheduled for implementation, triggering a new document version.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: The author documents the editing/completion of a change proposal.

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: The system automatically creates a validity extension request 30 days before the document's valid-until date.

evts.name: process_validity_extension
evts.description: The validity extension workflow is processed; participants decide to extend validity or trigger revision/override.

attributes.name: outcome
attributes.description: Validity extended, revision initiated, or override requested.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: The document's validity is confirmed and the valid-until date is updated by the default period.

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: A user with write access creates a request to invalidate a document.

evts.name: process_override
evts.description: The override workflow is processed through its steps (initiator check, review, release).

attributes.name: outcome
attributes.description: Override confirmed or rejected.

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: The document is declared out of force; all rights except archive group are revoked and archive duration starts.

evts.name: physical_deletion
evts.description: After the archive period expires, the document is physically deleted from the system.

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: A Business Admin group member creates a request to reactivate an archived document.

evts.name: confirm_reactivation
evts.description: The initiator confirms reactivation, creating a new version of the document with restored metadata and authorizations.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: User groups or persons are assigned to a document's distribution list for email or acknowledgement distribution.

attributes.name: distribution_type
attributes.description: Email notification or acknowledgement.

evts.name: send_distribution_email
evts.description: Email notifications are sent to distribution list members upon document release.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Acknowledgement workflow tasks are sent to distribution list members upon document release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A user confirms acknowledgement of a released document version.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: A released document's content is translated into another language.

attributes.name: target_language
attributes.description: The language into which the document is translated.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: The translated version is checked and released via a workflow, making it visible in the corresponding login language.

attributes.name: target_language
attributes.description: The language of the released translation.
